title: Alpaca Agent connects a mount's guider for any client, blocking the Guider Agent
description:
With indigo_agent_alpaca loaded, indigo_alpaca_connect_paired_guider() connected '<mount> (guider)' whenever the mount connected, regardless of the requesting client. The Guider Agent then refused the guider as busy or in use (forum thread t=1413). Fixed by connecting the guider only after an Alpaca client's PUT connected=true on the mount.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-20261101163708-4785-fix-alpaca-guider-autoconnect-001.json (category: functional, blocking: no).
